# Third-party notices

     `pnpm notices:check` fails when this file drifts from the release set. -->

Varlatch's own code is covered by [LICENSE](LICENSE). A Varlatch release
also runs, or contains, the third-party components below. Each is under
its own license.

**The Convex backend is source-available, not open source.** It is
licensed under FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0: internal use is permitted, making it
available to others as a competing commercial product or service is not,
and each version becomes Apache-2.0 two years after its release.
Self-hosting Varlatch for your own organization is internal use. The
Convex client library and CLI (`convex` on npm) are Apache-2.0.

## Container images the release runs

| Component | Image | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Caddy | `caddy:2.10.2` | [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy/blob/master/LICENSE) |
| Convex backend | `ghcr.io/convex/convex-backend@sha256:b441769e35f861e6e07f1e7ff7a476e56765fa948d61c1f5356685788d78c47d` | [FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0](https://github.com/convex/convex-backend/blob/main/LICENSE.md) |
| PostgreSQL | `postgres:17.6` | [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/) |
| Tailscale | `tailscale/tailscale:v1.102.3` | [BSD-3-Clause](https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/blob/main/LICENSE) |

The release manifest (`varlatch-release.json`) pins each of these by digest.

## Base images of Varlatch's images

| Base image | Used by | License | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nginx:1.31.9-alpine` | varlatch-web | BSD-2-Clause (nginx) | nginx on Alpine Linux; Alpine packages are under their own licenses |
| `node:26-slim` | convex-deploy, varlatch-web, varlatchd | MIT (Node.js) | Node.js, whose LICENSE lists the components it bundles, on Debian; Debian packages are under their own licenses |

The convex-deploy image also contains `generate_key` from the Convex
backend image above, under the same FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 license.

## Code ported into Varlatch

Third-party code adapted into Varlatch's own source files. Each file
keeps the code's copyright and license notice, and its SPDX header names
both licenses.

| Project | Version | License | What | Files |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [ada](https://github.com/ada-url/ada/blob/b12a893a45809da8103bb4f1e2f6f5ee13f9100b/src/ada_idna.cpp) | 4.0.0 (`b12a893a4580`) | MIT | Domain to ASCII and label validity (ada::idna::to_ascii and is_label_valid), ported to Go. ada is dual-licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT; Varlatch takes it under MIT. | `go/lib/whatwg/idna.go` |
| [PostgreSQL](https://ftp.postgresql.org/pub/source/v17.6/postgresql-17.6.tar.bz2) | 17.6 (`REL_17_6`) | PostgreSQL | timestamptz input (ParseDateTime, DecodeDateTime and their helpers in src/backend/utils/adt/datetime.c, tm2timestamp in timestamp.c), zone lookup (pg_tzset and pg_open_tzfile in src/timezone/pgtz.c) and the Default timezone abbreviations (src/timezone/tznames/Default), ported to Go; tzload, tzparse, pg_next_dst_boundary and pg_interpret_timezone_abbrev come from PostgreSQL's src/timezone/localtime.c, the IANA tz code, which is in the public domain. | `go/server/pgtime/abbrevs.go`, `go/server/pgtime/pgtime.go`, `go/server/pgtime/zone.go` |
| [smol-toml](https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml/tree/v1.9.0/src) | 1.9.0 (`6f9739a5ab48`) | BSD-3-Clause | The TOML parser (parse, and the key, value, string, number and date readers with their error messages), ported to Go so the Go CLI reads varlatch.toml exactly as the TypeScript CLI, which bundles smol-toml, reads it. | `go/cmd/varlatch/internal/toml/toml.go` |
| [V8](https://github.com/v8/v8/tree/14.6.202/src/date) | 14.6.202 (`e04c3a1a2543`) | BSD-3-Clause | The date parser behind Date.parse (src/date/dateparser.h, dateparser-inl.h and dateparser.cc, with ParseDateTimeString and MakeDay from date.cc), ported to Go so the Go CLI reads timestamps as the Node.js that runs the TypeScript CLI does. | `go/cmd/varlatch/internal/jsval/date.go` |

## License texts

Copied from each package's own license file. Identical texts are listed
once, with every package that uses them.
Packages only in the convex-deploy image keep their license files in the
image, under `/app/node_modules`.

# Third-Party Licenses

`modernc.org/sqlite` is BSD-3-Clause; that license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE) and it is
not repeated here. This file accounts for everything else -- every other body of code,
of any origin, that reaches you through this repository.

The list is **transitively flattened**. It is not the direct dependencies of
`go.mod`: it is the whole module graph, `go list -m all`, plus the third-party C that
was transpiled into Go and committed here, plus the upstream notices that dependencies
carry in turn -- musl libc, for one, reaches you through `modernc.org/libc` and appears
below on its own account. Each component is classified by what it actually does to a
program that imports this driver, because "a dependency" and "code in your binary"
are not the same question:

- [1. Components linked into your program](#1-components-linked-into-your-program)
- [2. Components used only by the test suite](#2-components-used-only-by-the-test-suite)
- [3. Components in the module graph, not compiled into anything](#3-components-in-the-module-graph-not-compiled-into-anything)
